transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Tech Solutions, this is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi Sarah, I’m having trouble accessing my account, and I can't remember my password.

Agent: I can help with that! Could you please provide me with the email address associated with your account?

Customer: Sure, it's john.doe@example.com. I just need to get back in there to manage my subscriptions.

Agent: Thank you, John. I’ll send a password reset link to that email right away. Could you check your inbox and confirm when you receive it?

Customer: Okay, I just checked… I don’t see anything.

Agent: I apologize for the inconvenience. Sometimes those emails can end up in the spam folder. Can you take a look there?

Customer: I just looked, and there’s nothing there either. This is really frustrating.

Agent: I completely understand how that feels. Let me resend the link for you. Please hold on for a moment.

Customer: Thanks, I appreciate it.

Agent: I’ve just sent a new password reset email. Could you check again, please?

Customer: Yes! I got it this time. Thanks! But one more thing — I noticed I was charged twice this month. What’s going on?

Agent: I'm glad you got the email! Regarding the charge, let’s take a look. What subscription plan are you currently on?

Customer: I’m on the Basic plan. The charge from last month is there twice, though.

Agent: Thank you for the information. I see two charges likely due to a billing cycle overlap. We can issue a refund for the duplicate charge if you'd like.

Customer: That sounds good. How long will that take?

Agent: It should be processed within 3-5 business days. I’ll make sure to expedite this for you.

Customer: Great! Thank you so much for your help today!

Agent: You’re very welcome, John! If you have any more questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!

Customer: You too, thanks again!
